description: Refresh from Meta. Pulls current numbers from Meta for your account and every tracked competitor and writes today's snapshot, exactly like the portal's Refresh button. One Meta call per account, so it takes several seconds; every other Market Intel read serves the snapshots this writes. Five minutes are enforced between refreshes (429 too_soon carries retry_after_seconds). Send {} as the body. Slow: one Meta call per tracked account. Only call it when the stored snapshot is stale.
name: refresh_market_intel
